Problem.description: One thing that is wrong, and what to do about it.

criteria.description: The criterion ids this is about.
criteria.title: Criteria

fix.description: What to do about it, as an instruction.
fix.title: Fix

id.description: A stable id for this problem. The same problem keeps the same id between calls, so you can say which one you fixed.
id.title: Id

kind.description: limit: a number two places disagree about, or nobody decided. gap: something a senior tester always checks that no test does. copy: two tests that are the same test. weak: a test whose expected result cannot be judged true or false. depth: a criterion without enough tests, or without the kinds it needs. clarity: a word nobody can test. epic: the story is really several stories. missing: a criterion with no test at all.
kind.title: Kind

level.description: high: fix this before writing more. medium: fix it before release. low: worth a look.
level.title: Level

says.description: What is wrong, in one sentence.
says.title: Says

tests.description: The test ids this is about.
tests.title: Tests

Problem.title: Problem

RiskOut.description: One risk, scored and checked for tests.

category.description: What kind of failure it is.
category.title: Category

coverage.description: tested: a test names this risk or does what it describes. "probably tested": a test was claimed but its words do not match what goes wrong. no test: nothing reaches it.
coverage.title: Coverage

level.description: high: write a test for it or accept it in writing. medium: worth a test. low: note it and move on.
level.title: Level

max_score.description: What the score is out of.
max_score.title: Max Score

score.description: How bad × how likely × how hard to notice. Out of 125.
score.title: Score

tested_by.description: The test ids that reach it.
tested_by.title: Tested By

RiskOut.title: RiskOut

covers.description: The criterion ids this test proves, such as ["AC-1", "AC-3"]. Use the same ids you sent in criteria. A criterion no test names is reported as having no tests.
covers.title: Covers

expected.description: What must be true afterwards, worded so it can only be true or false. "The page shows: Locked for 30 minutes" — not "it works".
expected.title: Expected

id.description: Your id for this test, such as "TC-04".
id.title: Id

kind.description: What kind of test this is. "normal" is the path that works; "wrong input" is bad data or no permission; "at the limit" uses the exact boundary value; "unusual" is everything rarer.
kind.title: Kind

steps.description: What the tester does, one action per step. At least one.
steps.title: Steps

test_data.description: The exact values this test uses: the amount, the file size, the number of tries. Say "$50.00", not "an order over the limit".
test_data.title: Test Data

title.description: What this test proves, in one line.
title.title: Title

description: The risk answer: everything above, plus the risks themselves.

add_tests.description: Ready-written tests for gaps nothing covered. They are already in the shape this tool takes back, so you can send them straight in.
add_tests.title: Add Tests

ask_the_po.description: Questions no tool can answer because nobody has decided yet. Show these to the user — do not guess the answers.
ask_the_po.title: Ask The Po

fixed_since_last_check.description: Problem ids from `previous_report_link` that are gone now. Send the link you were given last time and this fills in.
fixed_since_last_check.title: Fixed Since Last Check

not_checked_in_this_call.description: Problem ids from `previous_report_link` that a different tool found and this one does not look for. They are not fixed — nobody checked. Call that tool again if you want to know.
not_checked_in_this_call.title: Not Checked In This Call

notes.description: Anything else worth knowing that is not a problem.
notes.title: Notes

problems.description: Everything wrong, worst first. Fix every high one and call the tool again.
problems.title: Problems

report_link.description: A page showing this answer, for the person you are helping. Everything it needs is after the # — nothing is stored on the server and the server never sees it. Give the user this link.
report_link.title: Report Link

report_note.description: Set only when the answer was too big to pack the inputs into the link, so the page shows the findings without them.
report_note.title: Report Note

schema_version.description: The shape of this answer. It changes only when fields do.
schema_version.title: Schema Version

still_open.description: Problem ids from `previous_report_link` that are still here. Empty when no previous link was sent.
still_open.title: Still Open

summary.description: One line for a human to read, such as "6 to fix · 5 criteria · 14 tests". Show it; do not parse it.
summary.title: Summary

untested_high.description: The ids of high risks no test reaches. Write a test for each or say in writing why not.
untested_high.title: Untested High

title: RisksOut
